arxiv-2109-11440.title: Local invertibility and sensitivity of atomic structure-feature mappings
arxiv-2109-11440.creator: Sergey N. Pozdnyakov, Liwei Zhang, Christoph Ortner, Gábor Csányi, Michele Ceriotti
arxiv-2109-11440.description: Abstract The increasingly common applications of machine-learning schemes to atomic-scale simulations have triggered efforts to better understand the mathematical properties of the mapping between the Cartesian coordinates of the atoms and the variety of representations that can be used to convert them into a finite set of symmetric descriptors or features .

arxiv-2302-11944.title: Counterfactual Situation Testing: Uncovering Discrimination under Fairness given the Difference Conference: Equity and Access in Algorithms, Mechanisms, and Optimization; October 30-November 1, 2023; Boston, MA, USA Equity and Access in Algorithms, Mechanisms, and Optimization (EAAMO ’23), October 3
arxiv-2302-11944.creator: Jose M. Alvarez, Salvatore Ruggieri
arxiv-2302-11944.description: Abstract . We present counterfactual situation testing (CST), a causal data mining framework for detecting individual discrimination in a dataset of classifier decisions. CST answers the question “what would have been the model outcome had the individual, or complainant, been of a different protected status?” in an actionable and meaningful way.

arxiv-2407-12190.title: On a possible ϕ 3 {}^{3}_{\phi} H hypernucleus with HAL QCD interaction
arxiv-2407-12190.creator: I. Filikhin 1 , R. Ya. Kezerashvili 2,3,4 , and B. Vlahovic 1
arxiv-2407-12190.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by I. Filikhin 1 , R. Ya. Kezerashvili 2,3,4 , and B. Vlahovic 1. Within the framework of the Faddeev formalism in configuration space, we investigate bound states in the ϕ ​ N ​ N \phi NN system with total isospin T = 0 T=0 and T = 1 T=1 .

arxiv-2410-13148.title: Learning Efficient Representations of Neutrino Telescope Events
arxiv-2410-13148.creator: Felix J. Yu, Nicholas Kamp & Carlos A. Argüelles
arxiv-2410-13148.description: Abstract Neutrino telescopes detect rare interactions of particles produced in some of the most extreme environments in the Universe. This is accomplished by instrumenting a cubic-kilometer volume of naturally occurring transparent medium with light sensors. Given their substantial size and the high frequency of background interactions, these telescopes amass an enormous quantity of large variance, high-dimensional data.

arxiv-2410-23767.title: HD-OOD3D: Supervised and Unsupervised Out-of-Distribution object detection in LiDAR data
arxiv-2410-23767.creator: Louis Soum-Fontez, Jean-Emmanuel Deschaud, François Goulette
arxiv-2410-23767.description: Abstract Autonomous systems rely on accurate 3D object detection from LiDAR data, yet most detectors are limited to a predefined set of known classes, making them vulnerable to unexpected out-of-distribution (OOD) objects. In this work, we present HD-OOD3D, a novel two-stage method for detecting unknown objects.

arxiv-2411-11969.title: Black Hole Supernovae, their Equation of State Dependence and Ejecta Composition
arxiv-2411-11969.creator: Oliver Eggenberger Andersen, Evan O’Connor, Haakon Andresen, André da Silva Schneider, Sean M. Couch
arxiv-2411-11969.description: Abstract Recent literature on core-collapse supernovae suggests that a black hole (BH) can form within ∼ 1 \sim 1 s of shock revival, while still culminating in a successful supernova. We refer to these as black hole supernovae, as they are distinct from other BH formation channels in both timescale and impact on the explosion.

arxiv-2602-12988.title: Multidimensional Dickman distribution and operator selfdecomposability
arxiv-2602-12988.creator: Anastasiia S. Kovtun, Nikolai N. Leonenko, Andrey Pepelyshev
arxiv-2602-12988.description: Abstract The one-dimensional Dickman distribution arises in various stochastic models across number theory, combinatorics, physics, and biology. Recently, a definition of the multidimensional Dickman distribution has appeared in the literature, together with its application to approximating the small jumps of multidimensional Lévy processes.

pmc-10735986.title: HOW SPOUSAL BEREAVEMENT SHAPES LIFE SATISFACTION: STABILITY AND CHANGE ACROSS HISTORICAL TIME
pmc-10735986.creator: Urmimala Ghose, Michael Krämer, David Richter, Gert Wagner, Frank Infurna, Nilam Ram, Denis Gerstorf
pmc-10735986.description: Lifespan psychological and life course sociological research have long shown that spousal bereavement constitutes one of the most stressful life events in older adulthood that is often associated with marked declines in well-being. It is an open question though whether and how the well-being implications of spousal loss have changed over the past decades.

pmc-11507441.title: Oilseed Cakes: A Promising Source of Antioxidant, and Anti-Inflammatory Agents—Insights from Lactuca sativa
pmc-11507441.creator: Mayye Majed, Amal A Galala, Mohamed M Amer, Dirk Selmar, Sara Abouzeid, Vassilis Athanasiadis, Theodoros G Chatzimitakos
pmc-11507441.description: This study evaluated the antioxidant and antibacterial properties of methanolic extracts derived from oilseed cakes of Lactuca sativa (lettuce), Nigella sativa (black seed), Eruca sativa (rocket), and Linum usitatissimum (linseed). Lettuce methanolic extract showed the highest potential, so it was selected for further investigation.

pmc-11652266.title: Polyphonia: detecting inter-sample contamination in viral genomic sequencing data
pmc-11652266.creator: Lydia A Krasilnikova, Christopher H Tomkins-Tinch, Alton C Gayton, Stephen F Schaffner, Sabrina T Dobbins, Adrianne Gladden-Young, Katherine J Siddle, Daniel J Park, Pardis C Sabeti, Can Alkan
pmc-11652266.description: SummaryIn viral genomic research and surveillance, inter-sample contamination can affect variant detection, analysis of within-host evolution, outbreak reconstruction, and detection of superinfections and recombination events. While sample barcoding methods exist to track inter-sample contamination, they are not always used and can only detect contamination in the experimental pipeline from the point they are added.

pmc-12450544.title: Carrier-free nanoparticles based on natural products trigger dual "synergy and attenuation" for enhanced phototherapy of liver cancer
pmc-12450544.creator: Xiongqin Wang, Kunhui Sun, Junlin Dong, Yanli Ge, Haifan Liu, Xingyue Jin, Xiao Pei, Ping Wang, Jianbing Jiang, Tiejie Wang, Xuelei Hu, Shuguang Yuan, Bing Wang, Xie-an Yu
pmc-12450544.description: Carrier-free nanoparticles have attracted significant interest owing to their exceptional drug-loading efficiency, simple preparation, and good biosafety. Inspired by the synergism and attenuation strategy of natural products, carrier-free nanoparticles were constructed from a compatibility perspective, aiming to carry natural products to tumor sites as nanoparticles to achieve precise anti-cancer effects.

pmc-12916606.title: Retrieval augmented generation in dentistry: potentials, applications, and future directions
pmc-12916606.creator: Tahereh Firoozi, Rojin Adabdokht, Hollis Lai
pmc-12916606.description: Retrieval Augmented Generation offers a robust framework for developing reliable and evidence- aligned artificial intelligence in dentistry. By integrating external knowledge sources with the generative capabilities of large language models, RAG addresses key limitations of standalone LLMs, including outdated parametric knowledge, limited domain specificity, and hallucinations.

pmc-13068234.title: Prevalence and factors associated with obesity in Rwanda: Evidence from the 2022 NCD STEPS Survey
pmc-13068234.creator: Nshimiyimana Gad, Bakang Percy Tlhaloganyang, Jean Claude Habineza, Niyonsenga Simon Pierre, Clarisse Musanabaganwa, Eric Remera, Amparo Elena Gordillo-Tobar, Alberto Barcelo, Fabrice Iradukunda, Ukuri Sincere Josue, Ntaganda Evariste, Akandi Pilote, Igiraneza Pacifique, Ndagijimana Albert, Uwinkind
pmc-13068234.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Obesity is an emerging public health concern in Rwanda, yet nationally representative data on its associated factors remain limited. This study analyzes recent survey data to assess the prevalence of obesity and explore associated demographic, behavioral, and metabolic characteristics. The study analyzed data from the 2022 Rwanda NCD STEPS Survey, a nationally representative cross-sectional study of 5,509 adults aged 18–69 years. Data collection followed the WHO STEPwise approach and included structured questionnaires, physical measurements, and biochemical tests.

pmc-13335956.title: NIR‐II‐Trackable LYTACs Phyto‐Nanotheranostics for Source‐Microenvironment Dual‐Track ROS Regulation in Acute Gouty Arthritis
pmc-13335956.creator: Jian Zhang, Yingying Wang, Lujie Yu, Chunmei Jiang, Haoyu Liu, Yaohua Chen, Shutong Wu, Qin Liu, Lingling Wei, Xiaochun Zheng, Huifang Hao, Mengting Gao, Weiwei Kang, Rong Dai, Ziliang Zheng, Ruiping Zhang
pmc-13335956.description: The acute gouty arthritis (GA) is critically driven by the NOX2‐mediated reactive oxygen species (ROS) explosion in macrophages, while current clinical drugs lack precise regulatory capability. Dealing with the challenge, a novel nanomaterial named TPR‐LYTACs has been developed in this study. The TPR‐LYTACs construction involves the assembly of a nano‐core (TPR) from tea polyphenols and acidified rutin.

pmc-13342745.title: Paradigms of precision: The ascendancy of microvascular couplers in maxillofacial reconstruction
pmc-13342745.creator: U. S. Pal, S. Hemanth Kumar
pmc-13342745.description: ructive surgery has evolved from a race for survival to a pursuit of highly efficient, reproducible, and precise outcomes, the tools of the trade have fundamentally shifted. The microvascular anastomotic coupling device—once viewed by traditionalists as a novel luxury—has transitioned into a definitive standard of care, completely reshaping the paradigm of free flap surgery.

pmc-13391349.title: SGLT2 inhibitors are associated with reductions in epicardial adipose tissue volume and thickness: a meta-analysis
pmc-13391349.creator: Shaun Khanna, Elana Kalman, Kaushik Thungathurthi, Udit Thakur, Sheran Vasanthakumar, Sohaib Virk, Aditya Bhat, Andrew Lin, Clare Arnott, Nitesh Nerlekar
pmc-13391349.description: BackgroundEpicardial adipose tissue (EAT), a metabolically active fat depot surrounding the myocardium, is implicated in the pathogenesis of cardiovascular disease. Sodium-glucose co-transporter-2 inhibitors (SGLT2i) have demonstrated cardioprotective effects beyond glucose lowering, including a modification of EAT. We performed a systematic review and meta-analysis to evaluate the effect of SGLT2i on serial EAT measurement.
